blocks.text:
You have sent me with this Kalimah! You have commanded me (to convey) it! You have promised Jannah for this Kalimah! You are the One who never breaks a promise.” Then, looking at us, he said, “Receive the good news that Allah Ta'ala has forgiven you!”
(Musnad Ahmad, Tabarani, Bazzar, Majma' az-Zawa'id)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﵌: مَامِنْ عَبْدٍ قَالَ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ ثُمَّ مَاتَ عَلَي ذلِكَ إِلَّا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ قُلْتُ: وَإِنْ زَنَي وَإِنْ سَرَقَ؟ قَالَ: وَإِنْ زَنَي وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قُلْتُ: وَإِنْ زَنَي وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ: وَإِنْ زَنَي وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قُلْتُ: وَإِنْ زَنَي وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ: وَإِنْ زَنَي وَإِنْ سَرَقَ عَلَي رَغْمِ أَنْفِ أَبِي ذَرٍّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الثياب البيض، رقم:٥٨٢٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ said, “If a person utters the Kalimah La ilaha illallah and dies upon it, he will reach Jannah!”, I asked, “Even if he has committed adultery and even if he has stolen?” He replied, “(Yes,) even if he has committed adultery and even if he has stolen.” I asked again, “Even if he has committed adultery and even if he has stolen?” He replied once more, “(Yes,) even if he has committed adultery and even if he has stolen!” (The third time) I asked, “Even if he has committed adultery and even if he has stolen?” He replied, “(Yes,) even if he has committed adultery and even if he has stolen!' Even if Abu Dharr's heart dislikes it, he will certainly enter Jannah!”

blocks.text: Explanation:- The word 'Ala raghm' that has come in the hadith is an idiom peculiar to the Arabic language. Its meaning is: even if you dislike this, and even if you think it should not happen, it will certainly happen.
